depts.msum: L'Oréal leads the world beauty groups, ahead of Unilever, Procter & Gamble and Estée Lauder (first half of 2026). In China the home-grown Proya leads skin care; in India Hindustan Unilever and Himalaya lead; in Brazil Natura and Grupo Boticário are almost level. L'Oréal leads skin care in the United States (18 %), United Kingdom (15 %) and Germany (16 %, with Beiersdorf at 15 %); in France Cosmétique Active International leads (15 %); in Japan Shiseido leads (13 %) (all 2025). In Poland the national leaders by 2023 revenue are Eveline Cosmetics, Ziaja and Dr. Miele Cosmed Group; in Japan KOSE, Shiseido and Kao lead skin care.

ax: Which part of the body or which routine is it for: skin, make-up, hair, shaving and hair removal, teeth, washing and hygiene, or comfort?
key: 1. Is it put on skin to cleanse, moisturise, treat it or shield it from sun and insects? → Skincare
2. Is it a colour or a tool for colouring the face, eyes, lips or nails, or a traditional mark or body paint? → Make-up
3. Is it for hair on the head: washing, styling, colouring, drying, heat-styling, brushing or a wig? → Hair
4. Does it remove hair or tend a beard: razor, shaver, hair clipper, wax, epilator, beard oil? → Shaving & hair removal
5. Is it for cleaning teeth, tongue or dentures? → Oral care
6. Is it for washing, the bath, periods, intimate or baby hygiene, or a bathroom mirror, bag or scale? → Bath, body & hygiene
7. Is it a massager or a heat source to ease the body? → Comfort & massage

Precedence: a depilatory or razor is step 4 before skincare; a head hair clipper is step 4, not step 3; wipes for the face are step 6; a tinted moisturiser is a foundation (step 2) when sold for colour.
